column1: # One item in two states: an open or lit id and the closed or unlit id it is booked as.
# Opening a bag or lighting a lantern swaps the item id; the snapshot reads both as the same item.
# variant id <TAB> base id <TAB> RuneLite gameval names (variant=base)
# A seedling, watered or not, is the sapling it grows into, in the pack or the bank (Wiki "Seedling";
# GP Per Hour 1.22 values them the same way): sowing books the sapling, growing books nothing.
